name: Orchestrion Trumpet
summary: Electro-acoustic ESP32 MIDI trumpet that drives a loudspeaker into a real trumpet resonator and optionally actuates its valves.

notes: README documents ESP32-S3 and ESP32-WROOM-32 variants, including 4 MB and 8 MB WROOM environments.
The project belongs to the GMB ecosystem, but the audited README does not document the GMB discovery protocol; General-Midi-Boop currently lists trumpet integration under 'soon to come'.

mechanics.summary: A speaker in a sealed chamber acoustically excites the real trumpet leadpipe while one to four optional servo or solenoid actuators move valves for physical behaviour and presentation.
notes: The acoustic chamber and speaker coupling are core mechanical/acoustic parts of the build.

actuators.notes: One to four valves can each independently use servo actuation.
One to four valves can each independently use solenoid actuation.

notes: Servo and solenoid loads require separate actuator power; project safety documentation requires flyback protection, fusing and a physical emergency stop.

steps: Connect to the generated MIDI-Trumpet hotspot.
Complete the setup wizard for board, audio chain, valves, MIDI and calibration.

warnings: Project documentation explicitly states that software is ahead of hardware and the remaining work is physical bench validation.
